experiment: E73c native22 frozen SupCon with generic sample-template pair head
iteration_reason: E73b native22 pair AUROC was 0.986889 but detection AUROC was 0.914144; change only the sample-template matching head while freezing the encoder and all outer roles/runs

pair_head.type: symmetric MLP on elementwise product, absolute difference, and cosine
pair_head.training_data: enrolled subjects only; runs 0-2; opposite-session sample/template pairs; both directions share one head per outer fold
pair_head.forbidden_data: calibration_unknown and outer_unknown identities, labels, scores, thresholds, and model selection

protocol.threshold: per-direction q05 of enrolled-known run-4 maximum pair logit
protocol.working_threshold: per-direction q02 of the same enrolled-known run-4 maximum pair logit
protocol.outer_rule: freeze all three fold heads and both direction thresholds before any outer run-5 scoring; evaluate once without selection

reporting.AUC: same/different query-template pair AUROC and known/unknown detection AUROC
reporting.F1: identity macro-F1 and unknown-F1 at frozen known-only q05
reporting.test: N/A; competition Train and Test are not read
